summary: Applies a fixed multi-band graphic equalizer to audio channels, with band parameters spanning low bass through high-frequency ranges.
key_concepts: Audio Band EQ CHOP is a 16-band graphic equalizer for filtering audio input channels.
The fixed bands span from 25 Hz to 22 kHz, with one boost/cut parameter per band.
Each band's bandwidth is derived from neighboring bands, making it suitable for graphic-EQ shaping rather than arbitrary filter design.
Dry/Wet Mix blends the filtered result with the original input signal.
Use Audio Para EQ CHOP when variable center frequency or bandwidth is required instead of fixed band sliders.

key_params.name: drywet
key_params.note: Blend filtered output with the dry input

common_gotchas: This is the current replacement for the older Band EQ CHOP.
Band gains are fixed-frequency controls, so use Audio Para EQ CHOP when variable center frequency or bandwidth is needed.
Audio-rate filtering expects sensible sample rates; mismatched input rates can change the perceived band positions.
Large boosts can clip downstream audio unless gain staging or limiting is applied.
